unit_requirement: Two complete already-exposed prose contexts, including every exact group and alternative reading, nominated before new meanings. Exact context/source IDs and prospective meaning bindings are missing; producer reads no manuscript bodies.
inherited_stops: FM/FN and older models remain byte-for-byte unchanged. No arbitrary SHOL gloss, Motion repair, inherited qualities, Latin default, capacity rerun, new decoder or global framework.
title: RAW UNREVIEWED: a named comparison control is introduced and re-used without becoming the processed patient
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_UNTESTED. A whole passage may choose a comparison control, evaluate an owned sample against it and draw a relation or branch decision. A later nominal can return to the chosen standard while the processed sample persists separately. The speculative distinction is reference role versus action patient, not another metal name or a free reference repair.

design.mechanism: Introduce sample and standard separately; state the measured or observed property used for comparison; retain the chosen standard through the comparison conclusion or a later selection. Only the explicitly processed participant bears a material-changing action. A comparator mention is an argument of comparison, not automatically a new operation input.
design.unit: Two complete already-exposed prose contexts, including every exact group and alternative reading, nominated before new meanings. Exact context/source IDs and prospective meaning bindings are missing; producer reads no manuscript bodies.
design.contrast: Persistent sample plus selected standard/comparison result versus latest-nominal patient substitution, or two nominal mentions interpreted as successive transformation products.
design.prediction: One fixed comparison operator and typed argument order must generate both whole accounts. The standard must be entered in writing and re-used with a paid reference, while any processing predicate retains its separately bound sample. Swapping comparator and patient must produce an explicit changed ordering or decision; English coherence and reference proximity are insufficient.
design.scope: Speculative comparator-role route, distinct from executing the existing crown, stone or gold stories. No source copying, new assay, nominal census or current backward-reference change.

missing_inputs: Whole paired contexts with explicitly introduced comparison participants
A written comparison property and role/order marker compatible with the complete groups
Fixed standard-selection/re-use binding, including barriers and alternates
Verified complete historical comparison passage before scientific selection
required_falsifier: Reject if standard selection has no written owner, if later action can only be bound by turning the comparator into its patient, or if fixed role reversal leaves the claimed discriminating conclusion unchanged.
exact_changed_research_decision: Adds a reference-standard account of recurring nominals to the raw rivals; permits selection only after a whole written sample/control distinction is paid.
